bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone or email (springmoonphk@peninsula.com). A card hold of HK$330 a guest is taken when booking.
cancellation: Change or cancel at least 48 hours ahead. Later than that, or for a no-show, the HK$330-a-guest advance payment is kept. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
dressCode: Smart casual. No sportswear or beachwear (vests, exercise shorts, leggings, flip-flops). Knee-length shorts, jeans, T-shirts and trainers are fine at lunch; at dinner men need closed shoes, long trousers and sleeved shirts.
children: Children of all ages are welcome.
